t: Powerful, intensive, fast-drying cleaner. Formulated to quickly and safely remove brake fluid, grease, oil and other contaminants from machine parts, disc brakes as well as brake and clutch parts. Non-staining, non-corrosive. Can be applied without disassembly. Helps brakes last longer, increases performance and assists with reducing disc brakes squeal and slipping clutches. Evaporates quickly, leaving no residue.
